item.title: K-Pop Culture Shock with the 2026 Hyundai Stargazer X | AutoDeal Feature
item.description: We go dancing with the Stargazer X on this special feature. We have yet another Korean Culture trip brought to us by Hyundai. The new Stargazer is our chariot of choice in this epic around-town Korean experience. Whether your experience is near or far, the Stargazer X does it all and more. In this special, check out the team slurp some spicy noodles, pick up a special guest, and dance to some K-Pop, all in this special feature.
